notes.title: Peasant Dream: Ascension Demo is here!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45697869/40963c86da359edba7673b697ddc9b36dffc79ec.png"][/img][b]The Peasant Dream: Ascension Demo is now available for you to explore the dungeon![/b]
Are you ready to begin your journey to become a Gold Rank adventurer?[/p][p]This demo lets you experience all core systems, though progress is, of course, limited past a certain point in the gameplay. Still, you're free to test key features like gaining reputation in the village, passing the adventurer exam, having fun with girls, exploring some romance options, and uncovering the dungeon’s many challenges.[/p][p][b]Happy exploring, adventurers![/b]
Have fun~~[/p][p][/p][p][/p]
